en: [But withal,] no sustenance do I ever demand of them, nor do I demand that they feed Me:

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
ur:

ur:
